name: orchestra
description: Orchestra — AI-Native Workflow Automation and Orchestration Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker,scheduler,ai -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @algoverge/api" "npm run dev -w @algoverge/web" "npm run dev -w @algoverge/worker" "npm run dev:scheduler" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @algoverge/shared && npm run build -w @algoverge/core && npm run build -w @algoverge/ai-agent && npm run build -w @algoverge/engine && npm run build -w @algoverge/api && npm run build -w @algoverge/web && npm run build -w @algoverge/worker && npm run build -w @algoverge/scheduler
scripts.test: npm run test -w @algoverge/api && npm run test -w @algoverge/engine
